### Summary
The mobile app project is progressing with some delays. The team has completed the login rework, but the payments integration is blocked due to pending credentials from FinServe. The project is on track with budget and scope, but a decision is needed to ensure timely launch.

### Progress
- Login rework completed (9 days instead of 5)
- 70% of project scope is done, with 61% of the budget spent

### Risks and Blockers
- Payments integration blocked for 11 days, awaiting sandbox credentials from FinServe
- 34 bugs found in QA, 6 of which are critical (mostly on Android 13)
- Potential launch delay if loyalty points screen is included

### Decisions Needed
- Ship the app without the loyalty points screen or delay the launch by 2 weeks
